Šta smernice kažu o PrEP-u: What the guidelines say about PrEP
PrEP je preventivni lek za osobe koje ne: PrEP is preventive medication for people who do not have HIV. When taken as prescribed, it reduces the risk of acquiring HIV through sex by more than 99%. An HIV test and a medical assessment are needed before starting. With oral PrEP, regular HIV testing and medical reviews usually take place every three months. PrEP does not protect against other sexually transmitted infections.
